args.body: Take CATALOGUE-AGENCY-BUYER-TRIAL under a valid lease and reuse the saved buyer-route and order-handoff evidence. Exclude the existing item 4 pilot, prior listings and procurement portals. Within the two-original-request limit, prioritize a current buyer-authored request that explicitly seeks paid catalogue reconciliation or release QA and publishes a permitted response route. For the first fit, run the existing checker on one fictional before/after pair tied to a quoted buyer criterion. Save the source URL and hash, exact command, actual output and copy-ready bilingual operator response with AI disclosure. Cite only the verified live offer. If neither request qualifies, save the controlling exclusion and the specific new evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No contact, submission, registration, spend or deployment.

description: The UK Contracts Finder trial closed without a verified actionable fit. One retrieval returned HTTP 403, which limits what that trial can establish. The next test uses the existing catalogue checker and order handoff against a current agency buyer’s stated acceptance criterion, without spending or building another product. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The commissioned-review release still requires host-confirmed independent approval of the exact digest. An eligible inquiry on the existing offer can proceed through the authorized private cycle. The welfare observation cutoff and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement remain in force.
